description: This source file contains unit tests for the TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer component in the OpenClawKit project. It tests the behavior of the watchdogTimeoutSeconds function with different language inputs and utterance lengths.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizerTests
classes.description: A test case class for testing the behavior of TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer, specifically the watchdogTimeoutSeconds function.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutDefaultsToLatinProfile
methods.description: Tests that the default watchdog timeout for generic Latin text is approximately 24 seconds.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutUsesKoreanProfile
methods.description: Verifies that Korean text sets the watchdog timeout to approximately 75 seconds.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutUsesChineseProfile
methods.description: Checks that Chinese text results in a timeout of around 84 seconds.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutUsesJapaneseProfile
methods.description: Ensures Japanese text yields a timeout close to 60 seconds.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutClampsVeryLongUtterances
methods.description: Tests that excessively long utterances are capped at approximately 900 seconds.
